Flow.description: When the stage is changed to “Quotation and Agreement Issued”, create an automated task for the opportunity manager “Chase Signed Quotation and Agreement”

value.stringValue: AND( ISPICKVAL([Opportunity].StageName, "Quotation & Agreement Issued") , NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE([Opportunity].StageName), "Quotation & Agreement Issued")), OR( [Opportunity].RecordType.Name='Agent Acquisition' ,[Opportunity].RecordType.Name='Renewal -Agent Acquisition') )
